svg.aria-label: Integration map: the exact mechanism joining Okta, Boundary, Vault, EKS, AWS, Datadog and GitHub Actions
svg.text: System to system: what each component calls, and what it presents to be allowed to
identity is proved, no secret sent
a credential is issued or read
OIDC issuer for the SA token
Boundary reads the groups claim to pick a role
password login read from Vault KV
API key read from SSM at boot
OIDC sub carries numeric ids: repo:owner@40911856/repo@1358281041
Not one of these arrows carries a password that was stored somewhere for it.
Machines present what they already are — an instance profile, a signed OIDC token — and receive something short-lived in return. The Kubernetes token lives 15 minutes,
the worker's Vault token 5, and the two broker passwords rotate weekly. Only the Datadog API key sits at rest, in SSM Parameter Store, read once at boot.
